_help: Your bookable hours, in Ottawa time (24h). Times always start on the hour. 'windows' apply every day. 'weekly' overrides one weekday (0 = Sunday ... 6 = Saturday), use [] for a day off. Anything busy in your connected calendar is hidden automatically, so you rarely need 'blockedSlots' now (it takes values like 2026-11-19 18:00). 'blockedDates' takes whole days (2026-12-25). Keep the commas right, or the page shows an error.
